terms.definition: In chemistry, a single element or compound, not mixed with any other substance.
terms.examiner: In everyday language "pure" means nothing added.

terms.definition: Pure substances melt and boil at specific temperatures; impure ones over a range.
terms.examiner: Use melting point data to judge purity.

terms.definition: A mixture designed as a useful product, with components in measured quantities, such as fuels, paints, medicines and fertilisers.
Separates substances in a mixture by how they distribute between a stationary phase (paper) and a mobile phase (solvent).
terms.examiner: Required practical. Draw the start line in pencil.

terms.definition: Distance moved by the substance ÷ distance moved by the solvent.
terms.examiner: Always less than 1. Compare with known substances.

terms.definition: A pure compound produces a single spot in all solvents.
terms.examiner: Different compounds have different Rf values.
